The findings are most consistent with autoimmune thyroiditis.

random.description: This image is a photomicrograph of splenic tissue stained with H&E, showing the microscopic architecture of the spleen. The section displays red pulp congested with red blood cells and white pulp surrounding central arterioles. There is marked cellular infiltrate and congestion characteristic of acute splenitis or a related inflammatory condition. The histological features demonstrate congestion and prominent inflammatory cell populations within the splenic cords.
